title: Expose persistent-motion intent and system preference without disabling essential feedback
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Provide the documented Reduce Motion preference with a clear supplied system-preference indicator and explanation that labels/state feedback remain. This controls intent only,not operating-system settings or unapproved accessibility modes. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/accessibility-settings/; provide index.tsx exporting AccessibilitySettings, AccessibilitySettingsProps and any named local types documented for B036. This task consumes part of A045, A085; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: The controlled toggle emits one boolean and does not mutate systemReduceMotion.
System and selected settings are clearly distinguishable to assistive technology.
Copy explains reduced decorative motion without promising to remove essential game feedback.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
